name: Air Arabia PJSC
summary: Air Arabia PJSC, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a low-cost airline providing scheduled passenger and cargo air transport, aircraft leasing, and travel agency services across the Middle East, North Africa, Asia, and Europe from hubs including Sharjah, Abu Dhabi, and Ras Al Khaimah. Founded in 2003, Air Arabia is headquartered in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, and was the region's first low-cost carrier.

name: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (PJSC)
summary: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (PJSC) generates, transmits, and distributes electricity, and manages water desalination, transmission, and distribution for residential, commercial, industrial, and governmental customers in Dubai. Established in 1959, DEWA also develops district cooling, solar energy, and smart-city infrastructure services, and listed a minority stake on the Dubai Financial Market in 2022.

name: Dubai Islamic Bank P.J.S.C.
summary: Dubai Islamic Bank P.J.S.C. provides Sharia-compliant corporate, retail, and investment banking services in the United Arab Emirates and internationally through Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury, and Real Estate Development segments, including consumer murabaha, home finance, and wealth management products. Founded in 1975, DIB is headquartered in Dubai and was the world's first full-service Islamic bank.

name: Dubai Investments PJSC
summary: Dubai Investments PJSC operates as a diversified holding company engaged in manufacturing, construction contracting, real estate development, healthcare, financial services, and education in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Dubai, the company manufactures construction materials such as glass and aluminum extrusions alongside its property and investment portfolio.

name: Emaar Properties PJSC
summary: Emaar Properties PJSC, headquartered in Dubai, develops, markets, and manages real estate through Real Estate, Leasing & Retail, and Hospitality divisions, including residential communities, shopping malls, and hotels. The company developed the Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, and also invests in financial services and entertainment ventures. Founded in 1997, Emaar is one of the largest listed real estate developers in the UAE.

name: Emirates NBD Bank PJSC
summary: Emirates NBD Bank PJSC, founded in Dubai in 1963 and operating as a subsidiary of the Investment Corporation of Dubai, delivers corporate, institutional, retail, treasury, and Islamic banking services. The bank offers deposits, loans, trade finance, investment banking, wealth management, and consumer financing products across the United Arab Emirates, Egypt, India, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and other markets.

name: Mashreqbank PSC
summary: Mashreqbank PSC provides wholesale, retail, treasury, and Islamic banking services to individuals, corporations, and small and medium-sized businesses in the United Arab Emirates and internationally, including trade finance, cash management, wealth management, and insurance products. Established in 1967 and headquartered in Dubai, Mashreq operates a network of branches across the Middle East, Asia, Europe, and the United States.

name: Parkin Company P.J.S.C.
summary: Parkin Company P.J.S.C. manages and operates paid public parking facilities across Dubai, including on-street, off-street, and multi-level parking, and provides permits, subscriptions, and advance booking services. Established in 1995 and headquartered in Dubai, Parkin holds an exclusive mandate from Dubai's Roads and Transport Authority to manage the emirate's public parking spaces.

name: Salik Company P.J.S.C.
summary: Salik Company P.J.S.C. designs, builds, operates, and maintains Dubai's electronic road toll gate system, managing toll points across the emirate on behalf of Dubai's Roads and Transport Authority. Established in 2022 and headquartered in Dubai, Salik holds an exclusive concession to operate Dubai's road toll network.
